svg.title: Model lab — models I've fine-tuned
svg.desc: Four animated cards for fine-tuned models: Donut (OCR-free document understanding), Qwen2.5-VL (vision-language), Qwen3-VL (vision-language with grounding) and Qwen3 (language model with thinking).
